recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-9540 unless a future work group decision reopens ConceptMap system/version modeling.
issue_request: FHIR-9540 was a Published FHIR-core ConceptMap change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking that ConceptMap source and target codeSystem elements be renamed to system and the newly added codeSystemVersion elements be renamed to version for consistency with ValueSet and CodeSystem.
initial_application: The Jira resolution says the change had already been done. Git history shows commit 7089931fcdcdea92b62c147d3d4966315566c14f, svn revision 7871, renamed ConceptMap example and spreadsheet fields from codeSystem/codeSystemVersion to system/version. FHIR-9726 identifies the same revision and records the subsequent ConceptMap.group reorganization from element-level names to group.source, group.sourceVersion, group.target, and group.targetVersion.
additional_context: ConceptMap is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. Current source/conceptmap/structuredefinition-ConceptMap.xml defines ConceptMap.group.source and ConceptMap.group.target as canonical(CodeSystem) elements and no longer contains ConceptMap codeSystem or codeSystemVersion elements. Later Published issue FHIR-25925 intentionally removed group.sourceVersion and group.targetVersion by making group.source and group.target canonical(CodeSystem). Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant conflicting community record.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current authoritative ConceptMap source no longer contains the old codeSystem/codeSystemVersion element names, and the later canonical(CodeSystem) refactor explains the current source/target shape.
